name: Skill Auditor
description: Checks a skill, plugin or MCP server before you install it. Runs nothing.
about: Point it at a skill, plugin or MCP server, as a folder or a GitHub URL. The skill-audit-mcp scanner makes a first pass, then the bot reads every instruction file and script itself, rules on each hit and on what the scanner missed, and says whether to install. It never runs anything from the target.
features: Rule on every scanner hit, with reasoning
Write a JSON report you can compare across runs
examplePrompt: Audit https://github.com/someone/their-skill before I install it. Is it safe?
